notes.title: The English translation has finally arrived!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First I would like to apologize for the delay in implementing this language, but now it is finally here!

Well... We prefer to keep the items and menus in Portuguese, but all dialogues have been translated in such a way that it doesn't compromise the experience of players who don't understand Brazilian Portuguese. I hope that this way we can open this universe and allow it to reach as many people as possible!

Once again, you can count on the support to report any errors you find, whether in dialogues or bugs in general. We will always be happy to make improvements to the game!

[b]Note: If you have already started a save, it will be possible to change the language at Rebeca's house on Drylands![/b]

I count on you, have fun!

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
Greetings!
For this update we have prepared a little surprise!

> BUG Fix
  - Some NPCs still had flaws and ended up delivering items infinitely (I hope nobody abused it)
- Swordsman class skills are completely updated.

> Graphic Update
- We made some modifications to the maps in order to give more life to the scenario and improve the location of the player within them.

> The renovated and accessible Dragon Temple!
- With a new look, the Dragon Temple can be accessed by players who have already completed the main story. I hope you enjoy what is waiting for you there ...

> Possible future updates
- We are considering the possibility of introducing a kind of "automatic save", we would like your feedback mainly on this issue, and if possible, new suggestions for updating.
Good game!

notes.title: Other languages
notes.content:
We are working to implement the possibility of having more languages in our game, we will implement the languages according to the demand of the community.
Coming soon.
